#  (theta = 180 is nadir-viewing; theta = 0 is zenith-viewing) 
# depth = -1.0 labels values in air (just above the sea surface)
# L_sky is incident sky radiance; theta = 0 to 90 deg only; in air only
# L_w is water-leaving radiance; theta = 90 to 180 deg only; in air only
# L_sr is surface-reflected radiance; theta = 90 to 180 deg only; in air only
# L_dir is in-water direct radiance; theta = 0 to 90 deg only; in water only
# L_dif is in-water diffuse radiance; theta = 0 to 180 deg; in water only
#    depth   theta    lambda  total radiance L_sky or L_dir   L_w or L_dif
# [m]    [deg]   [deg]   [nm]   [W/(m^2 sr nm)]
